panels.title: Request rate by path/status
panels.query: count by (path, status) of request log lines

panels.title: Deny rate (401 unauth / 403 cross-tenant / 400 validation)
panels.note: Deny + validation responses are correct behavior; excluded from the availability error SLI.

panels.title: POST/PUT /subscriptions latency p50/p99
panels.query: ms where path='/subscriptions' and method in ('POST','PUT')

panels.title: Mutations per tenant (audit-derived)
panels.query: count by (tenant, action) of audit rows where action in (create, update, rotate, delete)
